narration: Here's a habit quietly destroying your retirement — waiting to save whatever's left at the end of the month. Most people do it. Almost none of them save anything.
visual: Amber piggy bank centered on dark background with cash bills ($100, $50, $20) flying away from it. Hook text fades in: 'SAVE WHAT'S LEFT? This habit has a $384,000 price tag'

narration: Your brain treats money still in your account as money that's already yours to spend. By the thirty-first, there's nothing left — not because you're bad with money, but because you're human.
visual: Brain graphic on light background with three dashed arrows pointing down to icons: shopping bag, food plate, phone/subscriptions. Text: 'Available money = money to spend. By the 31st, nothing's left.'

narration: Studies show people who save what's left average just $127 a month. People who auto-transfer first? $441 a month. The only difference is which one comes first.
visual: Dark background with two animated bar charts growing side by side. Left gray bar labeled 'SAVE LAST — $127/mo', right amber bar labeled 'SAVE FIRST — $441/mo'. Bottom text: 'Only the ORDER is different'

narration: Run that $314 monthly gap through thirty years at seven percent and you get $384,000. That's not a mistake — that's just math working against you.
visual: Light background compound growth curve drawing in across a chart. Number counter rolls from $0 up to $384,000. Chart labeled '30 years @ 7% interest'. '$314/month gap' annotation.

narration: The fix is almost insultingly simple. Set up an automatic transfer on payday, before you touch a single dollar. Your brain can't spend what it never sees.
visual: Dark background, smartphone springs in showing an auto-transfer interface. Toggle switches ON animating from gray to amber. '+$441' lights up in the savings row. Check mark appears. Text: 'Your brain can't spend what it never sees'

narration: So here's the real question: are you saving what's left, or saving first? Because one of those builds $384,000 and the other one builds regret. Follow for more traps like this.
visual: Dark background split screen: left panel shows gray empty sad piggy bank '$127/mo SAVE LAST', right panel shows amber happy piggy bank with coins '$441/mo SAVE FIRST'. Big '+$384K' counter in amber below. CTA text fades in.
